remarks: Lovely Renovated Garden-Level Apartment in Downtown New Canaan  Spotless and move-in ready, this renovated garden-level apartment features a private covered entrance, private driveway, and scenic backyard. Located in the heart of New Canaan, it's just a short walk to Mead Park, trails, shops, dining, coffee shops, markets, theater, and the train.  The apartment includes a large bedroom that can accommodate a king-size bed, a new kitchen (stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave), in-unit washer and dryer, functional hallway nook, living room, updated tiled bathroom with shower, and a spacious walk-in closet or office space. Freshly painted with neutral tile flooring throughout.  Rent includes heat, hot water, electricity, and landscaping. Excellent credit and references required. A small, well-behaved dog (under 25 lbs) may be considered on a case-by-case basis.  Enjoy the convenience of in-town living with easy access to everything New Canaan has to offer.  Agent related to owner.
